blocks.text: Leaders of the United States, Japan, Australia and India announced Tuesday that their maritime patrol aircraft are scheduled to participate in an exercise in 2027 for the first time under the Quad security grouping. The announcement came in a joint press release issued after US President Donald Trump, Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi, Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese and Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi held a four-way summit in Manila on the sidelines of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) summit. The four countries unveiled the Indo-Pacific Maritime Surveillance Collaboration, a new initiative aimed at enhancing information sharing and maritime […]...
